Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software și Imobiliare
Who we are: 
 We are a software development company where people, passion, and technology come together to shape the future of real estate through our own innovative products.
 Since opening our doors in 2010, our Cluj-Napoca office has grown into the second-largest Yardi location worldwide. As part of Yardi Systems, Inc., a global leader in real estate software, founded in 1984, we’re connected to a network of over 45 offices and 10,000+ colleagues across the globe.
 Our success is driven by a diverse team of more than 1,400 professionals, including software developers, marketers, consultants, data researchers, customer service specialists, and many more. Think you’d be a great fit? Join #TeamYardi. 
 Your impact: 
 We're expanding our WordPress Development team and looking for a Web Developer with strong front-end skills to help build, maintain, and enhance the websites showcasing Yardi's real estate software products.
 In this role, you'll collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and other teams to turn business requirements and designs into responsive, user-friendly websites. You'll contribute to improving website performance, enhancing the user experience, and ensuring our company and product websites consistently reflect Yardi's brand identity.
 This hybrid role requires working from the office at least once a week, so please keep in mind that you should be based in or near Cluj-Napoca. Starting in January 2027, the in-office requirement will increase to two days per week .
 What you'll bring along: 
3+ years of professional experience in development, with a strong focus on front-end technologies
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or a relevant certification in software development
Solid knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with experience building responsive, user-friendly websites
Basic knowledge of PHP development
Familiarity with WordPress or willingness to learn its ecosystem, including themes, plugins, and page builders
Experience debugging web applications and identifying performance issues
Understanding of how web applications work, including HTTP requests, APIs, and browser-server interactions
Ability to independently handle moderately complex development tasks and seek guidance when needed
Strong communication and collaboration skills
 What you’ll do: 
Develop, test, maintain, and enhance WordPress websites, focusing on front-end functionality, responsiveness, and user experience
Translate design and business requirements into responsive, accessible web pages and features
Investigate and resolve functional issues, browser compatibility problems, and performance bottlenecks
Improve website performance, quality, and maintainability
Participate in code reviews and suggest practical improvements
Update and test WordPress, themes, and plugins to support site stability, compatibility, and security
Collaborate with designers, QA, Marketing, and other stakeholders to deliver reliable website improvements
Build your WordPress expertise and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team
 What you'll enjoy once you become part of the Yardi Romania team: 
A flexible hybrid work setup that blends the best of remote and office life.
Up to $2,000 per year is reimbursed for eligible learning and professional development expenses.
40 RON/working day meal tickets (taxable according to current legislation).
Up to 26 vacation days to recharge your energy, based on tenure.
Comprehensive private medical insurance (including dental care, physiotherapy & psychotherapy) for you and your dependents.
Up to 20 days of EU remote work per year, subject to current policy.
Annual salary review to keep in line with your performance and industry changes.
The possibility of a yearly bonus through our profit-sharing program.
Life insurance for you & global travel insurance for you and your family.
Currently granting a fixed monthly Work/Life Stipend for your well-being activities.
Discounts at gyms, restaurants, and other service providers.
All necessary equipment is provided for both home and office setups.
A modern, central workspace @ The Office in Cluj-Napoca, with an open-air terrace and game rooms to unwind.
Fresh fruit, snacks, and specialty coffee are available daily at the office.
Engaging office events, themed parties, and team buildings.
 Behind the Code: 3 Facts About Our Programming Department in Cluj You Should Know 
 Fact #1: We’re a team of 110+ colleagues in the programming team, so there’s plenty of support, mentorship, and new friends to meet!
 Fact #2: We place strong emphasis on stability at Yardi, and we’ve got the numbers to back it up. In 2024, our programming department had an impressive 97% retention rate! 
 Fact #3 : The average tenure in our programming team is 6.5 years ! We’ve built a supportive, diverse team where people stay, grow, and enjoy working together.
